message:
I remember one stormy evening when the kids decided it was a good time to test their ‘indoor camping’ skills right in the living room. Blankets draped over furniture, flashlights in hand, and a few too many snacks strewn about. While I enjoyed the chaos, I couldn’t help but think it’s good to have a plan in place for when Mother Nature decides to throw a tantrum. 

I came across a handy resource that outlines some practical steps for hurricane preparedness. It’s great for keeping the little ones engaged and teaching them the importance of safety without turning it into a lecture. 

What’s your favorite tip for making emergency prep a little more fun for the kids? 🌪️
